{{Top|leg}}
'''Skeedo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was a rival of [[Offra]] the Hutt during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Skeedo hired individuals to hijack one of Offra's arms shipments to the local militia of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skeressa]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Taking down a Rival}}</ref>
